methodology.paired_t_test: scipy.stats.ttest_rel on report-aligned pairs; None/NaN dropped pairwise
methodology.wasserstein_distance: scipy.stats.wasserstein_distance on all valid per-report values per group (marginal 1D empirical distributions; unequal n allowed)
methodology.js_divergence: normalized histogram on shared Freedman-Diaconis bin edges (numpy.histogram_bin_edges); JS = jensenshannon(p, q, base=2)**2 in [0, 1]

interpretation.wasserstein_distance: Earth Mover's Distance in the metric's native units. Higher = more mass must be transported to align RAG and Human histograms (larger distributional shift).
interpretation.js_divergence: Symmetric divergence in [0, 1] (base-2 JS). 0 = identical binned distributions; 1 = maximally different. Higher = greater distributional dissimilarity regardless of location shift vs shape difference.
interpretation.paired_t_test: Tests whether mean per-report difference (RAG − Human) differs from 0. Significant p (< 0.05) = systematic shift; does not measure effect size of distributional overlap.
